purpose: Local helper verification, not canonical extraction acceptance

unicode_regressions: A real pre-fix exported 1600-code-unit chunk splitting an emoji is rejected with ReviewError, not UnicodeEncodeError.
A complete emoji remains byte-for-byte unchanged in accepted source text.
additional_source_schema_regressions: Exact source_locator and projection/reference format remain review data.
Supporting public source pairs survive validation; credential-bearing links and invalid types are rejected.

captured_product_smoke.scope: Earlier real Arbey image smoke, preserved as historical evidence. Final helper suite includes real local OCR on a synthetic label; the Arbey smoke was not re-run after schema-only hardening.

limitations: The helper is not an OS network sandbox. It invokes an existing trusted local executable on normalized local PNG pixels and contains no network operation.
Recognition confidence is not factual certainty or source identity.
Real OCR is verified on a synthetic label plus one captured product image; no claim that all labels, languages or local systems work.
